rules.disease: Desmoplastic round cell tumor of the omentum
rules.sentence: Desmoplastic round cell tumor of the omentum, a mesenchymal tumor, results from a chromosomal translocation that fuses the Ewing sarcoma and Wilm tumor suppressor genes, rendering an Ewing sarcoma RNA-binding protein-1.[26]
